wins: Mapped the target network perimeter within the first 5 minutes, identifying the main gateway and three responding services.
Captured consistent service banners during reconnaissance, enabling focused enumeration despite no full exploit chains executed.
fails: Unable to escalate privileges after enumeration; required credentialed access not obtained, leading to mission failure.
Repeated service interruption when attempting brute-force authentication, truncating data collection windows.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance succeeded in establishing a clear view of services, but failure to acquire privileged access halted the kill chain before exploitation.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts fail due to missing credentials and patched service versions.

skill_cards.if_condition: When limited service visibility exists after initial ping sweep
skill_cards.then_action: Perform aggressive nmap scan with service/version detection

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH/HTTP services are detected with version banners
skill_cards.then_action: Extract and normalize banners for targeted exploitation mapping

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

memory_ops.reason: Consistently establishes accurate service map early in the kill chain.
Provides actionable context for next-stage targeting despite exploit failures.

next_experiments.title: Credential harvesting on SSH service
next_experiments.description: Integrate multifactor wordlist and default credential checks against discovered SSH version, capturing any valid logins for privilege escalation.

next_experiments.title: Exploit path validation with HTTP vuln scan
next_experiments.description: Run targeted OWASP Top 10 scan against the identified HTTP server to discover low-hanging remote execution or file inclusion vectors.

next_experiments.title: Persistence capability assessment
next_experiments.description: Test custom scripts that simulate persistence implants to verify write permissions and detection gaps on initial foothold attempts.
